title: Standard MURDLE — Quiet Launch Room Heist
subtitle: Standard mode: 5 suspects, 5 weapons, 5 locations
storyHtml:
Dynavics security flags flagged activity around a confidential product roadmap launch. Five team members entered three zones, each with a different tool and one evidence marker.

  • Every suspect used one weapon and occupied one room.
  • One full combination is the culprit setup.
  • Work through the story clues and keep your notebook consistent.

Need more elimination? Use the notebook logic and cross out each impossible pair.

clues.text: Aya was not holding the Drone.
Chen was not on the Rooftop.
The USB came from the Dock.
